I translate structured text (screenplays, transcripts, subtitle SRTs, story blueprints, ingested user text) from one language to another while preserving the original document structure.

[source_text] (single)
The upstream artifact to translate. Accepts ANY structured text: a timestamped transcript (timed segments + per-segment text — common source for bilingual / foreign-subtitle deliverables), a screenplay document, a story blueprint, or ingested user text. Payload is forwarded as raw JSON text; the LLM reads whatever structure it has and translates all human-readable fields while preserving keys, ids, timing, ordering.
